page.overview:
Who is Funamushi?

At some point, Funamushi and his wife had a son, Kobuna. Raising the boy as a true member of the Funato, he taught Kobuna to despise Kirigakure and commit himself to the clan.

Funamushi was typically a stoic man of few words, yet very methodical in his approach, able to see the situation before him and act accordingly, and willing to wait for an advantage. Likewise, as a commander amongst the Funato Clan, Funamushi is able to lead his platoon in absence of his superior Seiren. He is also a clever strategist and tactically able to outmanoeuvre his enemies, outplaying Kagura's plans by utilising a game trail for his men to launch an ambush. However, once in battle, he became very passionate, even sadistic as he would regularly taunt his enemies, hoping to make them suffer. He took pride in being a man of the sea, believing in survival of the fittest and that might makes right. He hated Kirigakure, believing they ruined the Land of Water's pride.

He was fiercely devoted to the Funato Clan. He was especially loyal to Seiren, his immediate superior, bordering on religious zeal. So utterly driven to serve them well, he committed himself to completing any mission assigned to him. Despite his normally composed nature, his loyalty to the Funato Clan as a whole made him overzealous to the point of being reckless. To which, wanting to defend their pride so absolutely, he desired nothing less than absolute victory and retribution to those who opposed the Funato Clan. He was also willing to sacrifice his fellow soldiers, even himself, to succeed. Likewise, he would assault any of his men who showed any wavering devotion to the mission at hand and would even ignore direct orders from his superiors to accomplish it.

However, despite his pirate nature and all-important desire serve the Funato Clan, Funamushi was not without some compassion to others. Being a husband and father, he took his role just as seriously, becoming role model to his family. Likewise, this led to some restraint when it came to innocent and non-combatant children. He was unwilling to harm them or using those who share those values as leverage, nor would he harm enemies ninja that showed similar compassion to children, so long as they did not harm his superiors. Funamushi presumably enjoyed beer, as a can was placed by his grave.
